description: Update the workspace's snapshot-retention policy: how long snapshots are kept before automatic cleanup. Pass retention_days to set it, or clear_retention to keep snapshots indefinitely (the unset state) — exactly one of the two. DEPRECATED upstream: prefer tenki_update_workspace_settings, which sets the same retention (and pause retention) alongside the quotas.

clear_retention.description: Remove the retention period so snapshots are kept indefinitely. Mutually exclusive with retention_days.

retention_days.description: Days to retain snapshots before automatic cleanup. Omit and pass clear_retention to keep them indefinitely.

workspace_id.description: Workspace (defaults to the key's first workspace).

name: tenki_update_snapshot_retention_settings
